scope.review_authority: Agent review of supplied source text and schema; not clinical expert adjudication

latest_findings.interpretation: No observed score loss attributable to generated alternative entity names in this oracle-entity subset. Same-label/type lexical scans and separate source review found no confirmed synonym FP/FN recovery.

historical_findings.semantic_review: Parent and subtype endpoints were reversed. Shared words must not turn the incorrect directed subtype edge into a true positive.

pending_relation_semantics.decision: Pending an explicit ontology decision and source adjudication. Not counted as accepted TP; schema does not declare symmetry.

candidate_coverage.interpretation: Canonical qualified disease titles did not ground to source. Requires entity/title-to-mention alignment review before candidate generation. A permissive final scorer cannot create missing predictions; removing qualifiers is not a verified alias rule.

review_categories.category: Negated criterion is not equivalent to an affirmative symptom concept
Parallel symptom wording can inform grounding; core versus associated relations remain distinct
Generic disease and qualified subtype are not synonyms
Silver causality strength needs review; current reverse membership edge is not thereby correct
Potential symmetry convention in historical outputs requires separate adjudication

evaluation_policy.diagnostic_matching: Maximum one-to-one within sample after locking exact TP; no prediction/gold reused
evaluation_policy.next_metric_design: Keep strict F1. A separate equivalence metric requires a frozen, source-reviewed alias/inverse/symmetry policy, preservation of type, negation and qualifiers, and independent validation.
